mentions.name: Self-built house
mentions.description: A self-built house: the structural shell and exterior were contracted out, while the owner is doing all interior work personally except plumbing, which is hired out. No permits or certifications are required in the owner's country. The owner moved in once the house was livable and expects to finish it next year.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a house. I contracted out the structural shell and exterior, then all the internal work I'm doing myself. Except for plumbing, I don't want to be responsible for creating a swimming pool.
